revisions.summary: Revival and first full specification pass (PR open for fourteen months). Status Stagnant -> Draft; adds Etan Kissling, Gajinder Singh and Carson as co-authors. Replaces the placeholder 'Parameters / MAGIC: TBD' section with a concrete 'ETH transfer logs' section: the emitting address becomes SYSTEM_ADDRESS 0xfff...ffe (citing EIP-4788), topics[0] becomes keccak256('Transfer(address,address,uint256)') (0xddf252ad...), topics[1]/topics[2] the zero-padded from/to addresses and data the big-endian uint256 amount, explicitly matching the ERC-20 Transfer event. revisions.summary: Revival and complete rewrite, 193 lines down to 88. Status Stagnant -> Draft; title becomes 'Block Gas Limit Accounting without Refunds' and the description 'Prevent Block Gas Limit Circumvention by Excluding Refunds from Block Gas Accounting'; Toni Wahrstaetter is added as co-author. The scope narrows from 'certain gas discounts and refunds' to refunds alone (specifically SSTORE-to-zero), with warm-access and revert-to-original discounts explicitly retained in block accounting. The specification is restated as two rules - user gas cost stays tx.gas_used = gas_used - gas_refund, and block gas accounting becomes block.gas_used += gas_used with refunds not subtracted - plus a Block Gas Limit Enforcement section. The whole EIP-7623/EIP-4844 data-availability framing, the combined calldata-floor formula, the Implementation section and the DA-heavy test cases are removed; the document is reorganised into standard EIP sections with new Rationale, Backwards Compatibility, Test Cases and Security Considerations.

revisions.rationale: Changes the instruction form (precompile to opcode), assigns the opcode byte 0x4b, replaces the return-data encoding with a stack result, and removes previously specified optional RPC surface. revisions.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 0aefdc9d5a4b: Update EIP-7843: change to opcode

It shall return one stack element', with an Output stack table and 'SlotNumber is an 8 byte uint in big endian encoding'; the fixed gas cost of 2 is retained. The Motivation is rewritten around two existing ways to obtain the slot number on chain - computing it from the block timestamp, or supplying it as calldata and proving it against the beacon block root using EIP-4788 - and the two optional JSON-RPC conversion endpoints and the 'Precompile' rationale sub-section are deleted.

Two disassembly test cases are renumbered accordingly (e812 becomes EXCHANGE 2 3, e8d0 becomes EXCHANGE 1 19).

revisions.summary: Rewrites the 'Disallowed immediate range' rationale. The new text first states the EVM property being preserved (it is not possible to jump into the middle of an instruction, which PUSH immediates uphold by being masked from JUMPDEST analysis), then explains that these instructions preserve it without changing JUMPDEST analysis by forbidding 0x5b and 0x60-0x7f in their immediates, then gives the masked-opcode alternative and why it would break backwards compatibility without bytecode versioning (EOF), and finally notes that the encoding can be reused by future immediate-carrying instructions. revisions.summary: Major respecification (PR #10765, 181 insertions / 60 deletions): retitles to 'Increase exit and consolidation churn'; reinstates the activation cap as MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT = 2**8, replacing MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_EXIT_CHURN_LIMIT; splits get_activation_exit_churn_limit into a capped get_activation_churn_limit and an uncapped get_exit_churn_limit; replaces get_balance_churn_limit with a rewritten compute_weak_subjectivity_period that weights exit churn 2/3, activation churn 1/3 and consolidation churn 1; routes exits through the consolidation queue whenever earliest_exit_epoch > earliest_consolidation_epoch using compute_consolidation_epoch_and_update_churn with 2 * exit_balance // 3; and adds full process_pending_deposits and compute_exit_epoch_and_update_churn listings plus reworked rationale and weak-subjectivity figures (~7 days). Introduces an [EIP-8071] reference.

revisions.summary: Cleanup and tweaks rewrite (PR #11869, 93 insertions / 72 deletions): adds Felix Lange as an author; replaces Nick's-method presigned deployment with deployment through the EIP-7997 CREATE2 factory using a mined salt; removes the EXCESS_INHIBITOR constant and its deployment-time inhibitor semantics; restructures the request-queue section into Write path / Fee getter / System call and adds that a SYSTEM_ADDRESS call carrying calldata permanently disables the queue via an inhibitor and that non-matching calls MUST revert; states that both contracts apply fee increases per write rather than at end of block, unlike EIP-7002; moves the request-type uniqueness statement below the constants table with a consensus-specs permalink; simplifies the deposit acceptance condition to msg.value >= amount * 1 gwei + fee; fills in Reference Implementation with ethereum/sys-asm links; and condenses Motivation, Rationale, Backwards Compatibility and Security Considerations into headed subsections.
